breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the uniform load by its single resultant for an exact deflection calculation, but equivalent resultants preserve force and moment, not the full beam-deflection response.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the error by stating 'Replace the distributed load with its resultant wL applied at midspan.' This directly mirrors the flawed instruction from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth removes this incorrect substitution entirely, requiring the use of proper UDL deflection formulas (wL⁴/8EI and wL³/6EI). The agent failed to identify or correct this inconsistency.
